enterprise_value.na_reason: Enterprise value is not meaningful for banks (deposits act like debt)
enterprise_value.label: Enterprise value

forward_pe.note: Price / analysts' EPS estimate for next fiscal year (FY2027)
forward_pe.label: Forward P/E

peg.note: P/E / expected EPS growth (6.9%, analysts' next-year EPS growth)
peg.label: PEG

ev_ebitda.na_reason: EBITDA is not meaningful for banks and insurers
ev_ebitda.label: EV/EBITDA

ev_revenue.na_reason: Enterprise value is not meaningful for banks (deposits act like debt)
ev_revenue.label: EV/Revenue

p_fcf.na_reason: Free cash flow is not meaningful for banks (loans and deposits run through cash flow)
p_fcf.label: P/FCF

fcf_yield.na_reason: Free cash flow is not meaningful for banks (loans and deposits run through cash flow)
fcf_yield.label: FCF yield

roic.na_reason: ROIC is not meaningful for banks and insurers (debt is their raw material); use ROE
roic.label: ROIC

gross_margin.na_reason: Banks and insurers don't have a cost of revenue
gross_margin.label: Gross margin (TTM)

ebitda_margin.na_reason: EBITDA is not meaningful for banks and insurers
ebitda_margin.label: EBITDA margin (TTM)

net_debt.na_reason: Not meaningful for banks (deposits and borrowings are their core business)
net_debt.label: Net debt

current_ratio.na_reason: Banks and insurers don't split assets into current / non-current
current_ratio.label: Current ratio

quick_ratio.na_reason: Banks and insurers don't split assets into current / non-current
quick_ratio.label: Quick ratio

debt_to_equity.na_reason: Not meaningful for banks (deposits and borrowings are their core business)
debt_to_equity.label: Debt to equity

debt_to_ebitda.na_reason: EBITDA is not meaningful for banks and insurers
debt_to_ebitda.label: Debt to EBITDA

interest_coverage.na_reason: Not meaningful for banks (paying interest is their core business)
interest_coverage.label: Interest coverage

fcf_ttm.na_reason: Needs operating cash flow and capex
fcf_ttm.label: Free cash flow (TTM)

fcf_margin.na_reason: Free cash flow is not meaningful for banks (loans and deposits run through cash flow)
fcf_margin.label: FCF margin (TTM)

fcf_per_share.na_reason: Free cash flow is not meaningful for banks (loans and deposits run through cash flow)
fcf_per_share.label: FCF per share (TTM)

cash_conversion.na_reason: Not meaningful for banks (loans and deposits run through operating cash flow)
cash_conversion.label: Cash conversion

checks.name: Profitable (positive ROA)
checks.explanation: The company made a profit relative to its assets.

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.explanation: The business generated cash from its operations.

checks.name: ROA improving
checks.explanation: Profitability on assets is better than last year.

checks.name: Cash flow above profit
checks.explanation: Operating cash flow is higher than net income, a sign of good earnings quality.

checks.name: Leverage falling
checks.explanation: Long-term debt relative to assets went down (or stayed at zero).

checks.name: Current ratio rising
checks.explanation: The ability to pay short-term bills improved.

checks.name: No new shares issued
checks.explanation: The share count did not increase, so owners were not diluted.

checks.name: Gross margin rising
checks.explanation: The company kept more of each sale after production costs.

checks.name: Asset turnover rising
checks.explanation: The company generated more sales per dollar of assets.

altman_z.na_reason: Not used for banks and insurers (the formula was built for industrial companies, and their balance sheets work differently)
